title: Quantum-Limited Subdiffraction Telescopy Requires Genuine Multi-Telescope Interference
summary: Conventional stellar interferometry reconstructs incoherent sources from pairwise mutual coherences between telescopes. Are such pairwise measurements sufficient for quantum-limited subdiffraction imaging with a telescope array? We show that for generic image-moment estimation, they are not. We consider weak incoherent light from a generic extended source observed by an array of telescopes, each supporting a single optical mode.
